//: Type-checks the JSDoc that lib/ already carries - 118 annotations across
29 files - without converting anything to TypeScript. `npm run typecheck`.
Scoped to lib/ deliberately. That is where the pure logic lives, it is what
both the SPA and the hub workflows import, and it is already annotated. The
22,000 lines of .vue components are a separate question with a much larger
answer, and checking them is not a prerequisite for this being useful.
IT IS A GATE. `scripts/lint.mjs` runs it, so CI does. It was deliberately
not one for as long as its error count was unknown - a red CI over a system
that is working teaches people to ignore the red - and that stopped being
the situation on 2026-09-18, when the count reached zero on TypeScript 6
and 7 alike. Ungated it drifts by whatever nobody happens to run: four new
findings arrived in one afternoon from a single commit.
The class of bug it is here for is the one LESSONS records: a schema field
spelled wrong compares as a constant. `s.status` where the field is
`submission_status` is `undefined` on every row, and `!== 'x'` is then
always true - which counted a whole roster as having accepted. That needed
its own bespoke test (tests/report-row-fields.test.mjs); a type checker
reading the same JSDoc would have said so for free.
`maxNodeModuleJsDepth: 0` is here because skipLibCheck only skips .d.ts.
Without it an imported plain-JS dependency is type-checked too, and
`punycode` alone contributed 16 errors in somebody else's code - noise that
buries the findings in ours. This note used to sit inside compilerOptions
as a `//` key, which TypeScript 7 refuses as an unknown option.
`types: [node]` is named because TypeScript 6 stopped including every
@types package by default. Without it, every `Buffer` and every `node:`
import in lib/ is an error telling you to install @types/node, which is
already a devDependency - 22 of those on 6.0.3.
THE ERROR COUNT IS NOW ZERO, on 6 and on 7, which is what made moving to 7
possible (2026-09-18). The parameters that used to be `@param {object}` -
the assignment document, a roster row, a report row, a lockdown record -
are typed from `lib/types.d.mts`, which scripts/generate-types.mjs derives
FROM schemas/. `npm run types` rewrites it and tests/generated-types.test.mjs
fails when it is stale or when a property is in one and not the other.
